messages:
jules: Heads-up — we're scheduling the v1 API shim sunset for next Tuesday 9am PT. Need a short docs playbook + PRs for: example snippets (TS/py), model swap instructions, and a rollback path. @pri can you own the examples? :wave:
pri: Yep, I can take examples. Quick Q: do we want to prefer model-compat aliases or explicit model names in snippets?
marta: prefer aliases when possible. customers using pinned names will need explicit instructions though.
jules: Agreed. For the docs page, let's show both. Minimal snippet difference:
```js
// v1
const resp = await client.models.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', input: '...'});

// v2
const resp = await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-alpha-v2', input: '...'});
```
pri: thanks — I'll swap out the older SDK calls in the ts/js examples. Will open a PR with both alias and explicit examples.
kai: Heads-up: the python SDK also changed call sig — function name is create in responses, and streaming API signature changed. Add a note about streaming tokens and timeout defaults.
docswriter: docs-bot: checklist created -> https://internal.redwood/docs/shim-sunset-checklist  (auto)
jules: @kai can you add the python snippet here? then @pri will mirror.
kai: sure. python quick patch:
```py
# v1
resp = client.models.generate(model='redwood-alpha', input='...')
# v2
resp = client.responses.create(model='redwood-alpha-v2', input='...')
```
pri: opened PR #4212 with TS + py updates + migration notes. pinging reviewers @marta @kai :eyes: 
marta: LGTM for content, one nit on wording under 'tokenization' section.
pri: fixed wording, updated tests (snippet runner). Added a canary note with rollback instructions.
jules: timeline: deploy of docs tomorrow at 10am PT, email comms to customers on Friday. If any blockers, flag now.
kai: small blocker: integration tests failing in CI due to a helper util that uses v1 shim. I'll push a fix now.
pri: sounds good, I'll hold PR until CI green unless it's a docs-only change.
jules: thanks everyone. I'll draft the comms. If you add more snippets, drop them here or in PR comments. :thumbsup:
